name: DayOne / Gaw Capital Fuchu Intelligent Park Tokyo data center campus
notes: DayOne states two purpose-built data centers are in development at Fuchu Intelligent Park with 80MW total IT capacity and 66,360 sqm GFA. Gaw/DCD reported phase-one groundbreaking; phase one is 18MW and targeted core/shell ready by mid-2027.

name: Mitsui Fudosan Hino DC
notes: Mitsui Fudosan says it decided to develop a new Hino DC. Trade-press/local reporting describes three planned data center buildings on the former Hino Motors site, roughly 114,000 sqm, with construction timing reported around late 2026 and ongoing resident opposition.

name: Equinix TY12x Tokyo xScale data center
notes: Equinix official Tokyo pages list TY12x as its first xScale data center in Asia, situated in Chiba on the outskirts of Tokyo, supporting up to 54MW of IT deployments.

name: Equinix TY13x Tokyo xScale data center
notes: Equinix official Tokyo listing includes TY13x for hyperscalers. Techerati reported TY13x opened in Tokyo in July 2023 with support for up to 36MW.

name: STACK Infrastructure Tokyo / Inzai campus
notes: STACK official site describes its Tokyo presence as a two-building, 36MW campus in Inzai, a Greater Tokyo hyperscale growth area.

name: Digital Realty Tokyo data center portfolio
notes: Digital Realty official Tokyo page lists four Tokyo data centers and about 127.5k m2 total colocation space. Exact MW capacity was not published on the checked page.

name: K's OSC Outsourcing Center
notes: K's Corporation official page describes its OSC as a data center. Tottori Prefecture lists K's as a data center operator connected to the Tottori Information Highway, located in Yonago City.

name: Tottori Prefecture Information Center data center
developer: Tottori Prefecture Information Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Tottori Prefecture official page lists Tottori Prefecture Information Center as a data center operator connected to the prefectural information highway, installed in Tottori City; company page gives headquarters in Tottori City at NTT Teramachi Building.

name: Secure Data Center Tottori
notes: Secom San-in official page says it developed Secure Data Center Tottori in Tottori City in April 2005; Tottori Prefecture also lists Secom San-in as a Tottori City data center operator.

name: GigaStream Toyama Nanto Campus
developer: GigaStream Toyama K.K.; Nanto City public-private partnership
notes: Announcement says Nanto Campus is a phased data center land development in Nanto City supporting 3.1GW at completion; city council approved phase-one land sale of about 13.1 ha to support about 400MW, with operations targeted for 2028.

name: Cosmo Park Kada / Asa GK Google-related data center site
notes: Reports based on Wakayama Prefecture say about 37 ha at Cosmo Park Kada in Wakayama City was to be sold for 5.94 billion yen to Asa GK, a Google-related company, for a data center; prefecture had also run a FY2022 data center attraction basic survey. Project details and capacity are undisclosed.

name: Yamagata Community Data Center
developer: Yamagata Community Data Center Co., Ltd.
notes: Official site describes Yamagata Community Data Center as a safe local data center for companies, organizations, and individuals, located in Nanokamachi, Yamagata City. No capacity published.

name: Shunan distributed data center hydrogen fuel-cell demonstration
notes: Honda official release says the companies started a demonstration in Shunan City, Yamaguchi Prefecture to operate a data center using by-product hydrogen and a stationary fuel-cell power station reusing FCEV systems; Mitsubishi's earlier release identified the data center as operated by MC.

name: Ube Information Systems data center
notes: Ube Information Systems official page describes its data center service with disaster-prevention equipment, security systems, and dedicated engineers. Capacity not published.

name: NSW Yamanashi IT Center
notes: NSW official page describes Yamanashi IT Center as a suburban data center about 90 minutes from central Tokyo. Fuefuki City company profile says the Yamanashi IT Center supports digital society infrastructure; third-party listing places it in Fuefuki City, Yamanashi Prefecture.

name: YCC Business Center data center floor
notes: YCC official site says its Kofu headquarters/YCC Business Center, opened in March 2017, includes a dedicated data center floor; YCC also markets data center services using its secure facility and operational experience.
